name: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
overview: Guy Fieri is combining everyone's favorite culinary competition with the most wonderful time of the year by delivering the ultimate holiday present — Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas. For the first time ever, 32 jingle-bell-rock-star chefs are teaming up as duos to make both sweet and savory dishes in a one-of-a-kind, holly-jolly tournament. These chefs will try to "sleigh" the competition for a shot at the $100,000 prize and some seriously sweet cash for charity. With festive flavors, fierce battles and enough Christmas spirit to stuff a stocking, the holidays have never been this delicious
